text:
Mike: Heads-up — planning a config-only deploy in ~20m to adjust tenant throttles, shorten request timeouts for low-tier, and nudge routing weights. Change window 23:00-23:30 UTC. No model/version updates. Please ack if you need to block.
Leah: Ack. I'll watch the console dashboards and prewarm caches. :eyes:
Sam: Can we include a tinybatch tweak? last 6h showed small tail latencies for seq>512.
Mike: yes will push batch.max_tokens: 64 -> 48 for low-tier tenants; leave medium/high as-is. Also timeout from 12s -> 8s for low-tier only.
Jordan: fine. What about fallback policy if we see queueing? Can we pin traffic to fallback-model=v1-compat for affected tenants?
Mike: plan: routePolicy: gradual-weight-shift with automated fallback to v1-compat if p99 latency > 1.2s for 5m. Rollback criteria in runbook below.
Sam: adding rollout checklist.
Sam: ```
# deploy checklist
- notify oncall
- monitor p99 latency, error rate
- if error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency regression > 20% -> rollback
- if KV cache miss rate spikes > 15pct -> rollback
```
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by Mike. Config-only changeset id cfg-202603-47 pending. Canary will start with 2% traffic for 5m then 10% for 5m then 100%.
ops-bot: Canaries limited to off-peak capacity. Notifying oncall: @Leah @Sam @Jordan. ETA start 23:05 UTC.
Leah: I'm on watch. I'll post status updates every 5m.
Sam: If we need an emergency rollback, `deploy-bot rollback cfg-202603-47 --immediate` will unpin and restore previous throttles.
Mike: thanks. tagging runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/config-rollouts (pinned). :thumbsup:
Jordan: ack. good to go.
Leah: go for deploy.
